name: FourierJacobi.Measure.coe_add_eq_coe_add_iff
statement:
theorem coe_add_eq_coe_add_iff (s n : ℤ) (v : WithTop ℤ) :
    (s : WithTop ℤ) + v = ((s + n : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ↔ v = (n : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using WithTop.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp only [WithTop.add_top, WithTop.top_ne_coe]
  | coe m => simp only [← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_inj, add_right_inj]
context:
set_option linter.all false -- [Emissary] lints are not drift; the kernel decides
